prototypes.title: Scenic route with learning stops
prototypes.problem: Industry-first samples hide the travel destination and scenery.
prototypes.new_structure: Destination cover, walkable stages, one learning question per stop and a compact takeaway card.
prototypes.visual_rule: Use a scenic overview first, then detail and route-context media in the existing carousel.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Original copy and attributed domestic media only; no invented logistics.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Replaces MockStudyCommunityData and local mock media without changing live APIs or screens.

prototypes.title: Museum and outdoor context
prototypes.problem: Museum notes can read like a formal catalog instead of a journey.
prototypes.new_structure: Arrival landscape, exhibit clue, guide explanation and outdoor return view.
prototypes.visual_rule: Alternate architecture, exhibit and surrounding-place images.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Omit unsupported dates, identities and historical conclusions.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Merged into existing rich text, stages and carousel.

prototypes.title: Landscape observation card
prototypes.problem: Scenic posts can stop at generic praise.
prototypes.new_structure: Panorama, one visible feature, guide question and one-sentence takeaway.
prototypes.visual_rule: Give the overview the largest weight and use detail/path images for context.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Unknown geology, ecology or weather effects remain questions.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Merged into stages, curation notes and post bodies.

prototypes.title: Multi-day scenic journey
prototypes.problem: Long travel notes become a flat stream of photos.
prototypes.new_structure: One destination line, scenic anchor and learning card per day.
prototypes.visual_rule: Use up to seven images, each tied to a day or transition.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Keep the route explicitly sample content and omit logistics promises.
prototypes.existing_comparison: Uses existing multi-stage rendering and media pager.

prototypes.title: Industry report disguise
prototypes.problem: Study-tour content can drift back to factory, construction, laboratory or surveying reports.
prototypes.visual_rule: Keep specialist visit assets outside the community study-tour feed.
prototypes.evidence_rule: Industry test fixtures belong to their own meeting categories only.

findings: industry-report drift rejected by focused tests
West Lake and Wuyuan cover assets replaced after visual review
manual visual review is still required before OTA publication
